Why do NASDAQ Market Makers Avoid Odd‐Eighth Quotes?
items.abstract: <jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title><jats:p>The NASDAQ multiple dealer market is designed to produce narrow bid‐ask spreads through the competition for order flow among individual dealers. However, we find that odd‐eighth quotes are virtually nonexistent for 70 of 100 actively traded NASDAQ securities, including Apple Computer and Lotus Development.
